verses.sloka: सा त्वेवमुक्ता वैदेही त्वनसूया ऽनसूयया ।प्रतिपूज्य वचो मन्दं प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥ २.११८.१॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvevamuktā vaidehī tvanasūyā 'nasūyayā ।pratipūjya vaco mandaṁ pravaktumupacakrame ॥ 2.118.1॥

translations.english: When Anasuya thus addressed Vaidehi who is free from any malice, she worshipped Anasuya and started speaking in a gentle tone.

verses.sloka: नैतदाश्चर्य्यमार्याया यन्मां त्वमनुभाषसे ।विदितं तु ममाप्येतद्यथा नार्य्या: पतिर्गुरु: ॥ २.११८.२॥
verses.transliteration: naitadāścaryyamāryāyā yanmāṁ tvamanubhāṣase ।viditaṁ tu mamāpyetadyathā nāryyā: patirguru: ॥ 2.118.2॥

translations.english: It is no wonder that a noble lady like you should instruct me this way. It is known to me that a husband is a guru to his wife.

verses.sloka: यद्यप्येष भवेद्भर्ता ममार्ये वृत्तवर्जित: ।अद्वैधमुपचर्तव्यस्तथाप्येष मया भवेत् ॥ २.११८.३॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapyeṣa bhavedbhartā mamārye vṛttavarjita: ।advaidhamupacartavyastathāpyeṣa mayā bhavet ॥ 2.118.3॥

translations.english: O noble lady, even if my husband is devoid of good conduct, he should be obeyed without showing any hesitation.

verses.sloka: किं पुनर्यो गुण: श्लाघ्य: सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रिय: ।स्थिरानुरागो धर्मात्मा मातृवत्पितृवत्प्रिय: ॥ २.११८.४॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ punaryo guṇa: ślāghya: sānukrośo jitendriya: ।sthirānurāgo dharmātmā mātṛvatpitṛvatpriya: ॥ 2.118.4॥

translations.english: What to speak of a husband if he is worthy of applause for his virtues, is compassionate, a subduer of the senses, righteous and ever affectionate like a mother and a father?
translations.hindi: भरत जी अपनी सेना के सांथ नाना प्रकार की मनोहर. धातुओं को देखते देखते चित्रकूट पर्वत के उत्तर की अशर चले जाते थे

verses.sloka: यां वृत्तिं वर्त्तते राम: कौसल्यायां महाबल: ।तामेव नृपनारीणामन्यासामपि वर्त्तते ॥ २.११८.५॥
verses.transliteration: yāṁ vṛttiṁ varttate rāma: kausalyāyāṁ mahābala: ।tāmeva nṛpanārīṇāmanyāsāmapi varttate ॥ 2.118.5॥

translations.english: Mighty Rama shows the same behaviour and treatment towards the other consorts of the king as he does towards his own mother Kausalya.
translations.hindi: भरत जी ने चित्रकुट से थोड़ी ही दूर पर एक आश्रम देखा जिसमें ऋषियों सहित भरद्वाज मुनि रहते थे

verses.sloka: सकृद्दृष्टास्वपि स्त्रीषु नृपेण नृपवत्सल: ।मातृवद्वर्त्तते वीरो मानमुत्सृज्य धर्मवित् ॥ २.११८.६॥
verses.transliteration: sakṛddṛṣṭāsvapi strīṣu nṛpeṇa nṛpavatsala: ।mātṛvadvarttate vīro mānamutsṛjya dharmavit ॥ 2.118.6॥

translations.english: Heroic Rama is affectionate towards king Dasaratha and is conversant with righteousness. Renouncing the sense of selfrespect he honours all the women on whom his father had cast his glance even once just as his own mother.
translations.hindi: बुद्विमान्‌ भरद्वाज जो के आश्रम के समीप पहुँचकर, अरत जी रथ से उतर पड़े और मुनि जी को प्रणाम किया

verses.sloka: आगच्छन्त्याश्च विजनं वनमेवं भयावहम् ।समाहितं मे श्वश्र्वा च हृदये तद्धृतं महत् ॥ २.११८.७॥
verses.transliteration: āgacchantyāśca vijanaṁ vanamevaṁ bhayāvaham ।samāhitaṁ me śvaśrvā ca hṛdaye taddhṛtaṁ mahat ॥ 2.118.7॥

translations.english: When departing for this frightful and desolate forest, the great (advice) imparted by my motherinlaw is firmly fixed in my mind.
translations.hindi: तब भरद्वाज जीने प्रसन्न हो, भरत जी से कहा--हे तात ! क्या तुम्हारी श्रीरामचन्द्र से भेंट हुईं ? क्या तुम्हारा मनोरथ सिद्ध हुआ ?

verses.sloka: पाणिप्रदानकाले च यत्पुरा त्वग्निसन्निधौ ।अनुशिष्टा जनन्या ऽस्मि वाक्यं तदपि मे धृतम् ॥ २.११८.८॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇipradānakāle ca yatpurā tvagnisannidhau ।anuśiṣṭā jananyā 'smi vākyaṁ tadapi me dhṛtam ॥ 2.118.8॥

translations.english: When I have been taught by my mother earlier, at the time of bestowal of my hand to Rama in the presence of the sacrificial fire (as witness) is etched in my mind.
translations.hindi: जब बुद्धिमान्‌ भरद्वाज जी ने इस प्रकार पूछा तव भाठृवत्सल भरत जी ने भरद्वाज जी को इत्तर देत हुए उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: नवीकृतं च तत्सर्वं वाक्यैस्ते धर्मचारिणि ।पतिशुश्रूषणान्नार्य्यास्तपो नान्यद्विधीयते ॥ २.११८.९॥
verses.transliteration: navīkṛtaṁ ca tatsarvaṁ vākyaiste dharmacāriṇi ।patiśuśrūṣaṇānnāryyāstapo nānyadvidhīyate ॥ 2.118.9॥

translations.english: O righteous one (Anasuya), after listening to your words the instructions given by my motherinlaw and my mother are renewed (remembered again). For a woman, no other penance is laid down (in scriptures) except service to her husband.

verses.sloka: सावित्री पतिशुश्रूषां कृत्वा स्वर्गे महीयते ।तथावृत्तिश्च याता त्वं पतिशुश्रूषया दिवम् ॥ २.११८.१०॥
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī patiśuśrūṣāṁ kṛtvā svarge mahīyate ।tathāvṛttiśca yātā tvaṁ patiśuśrūṣayā divam ॥ 2.118.10॥

translations.english: Having served her husband (faithfully), Savitri is honoured in heaven. You also, by following the same path of serving your husband, shall reach the heaven.
translations.hindi: स याच्यमानो गुरुशा मया च दृढविक्रमः । राघवः परमप्रीतो वसिष्ठं वाक्यसश्रवीत्‌ ॥ & ॥ हे भगवन्‌ ! मैंने और गुरु वसिष्ठ जी ने जब श्रीराम छे लौटने के लिए प्राथना बी) तव श्रीराम ने परम प्रसन्न हो बसिछ जी से कहा ॥ ६.॥ पितुः प्रतिज्ञां तामेव पालयिष्यामि तरवतः । चतुदश हि वर्षाणि या प्रतिज्ञा पितुर्मम

verses.sloka: वरिष्ठा सर्वनारीणामेषा च दिवि देवता ।रोहिणी न विना चन्द्रं मुहूर्त्तमपि दृश्यते ॥ २.११८.११॥
verses.transliteration: variṣṭhā sarvanārīṇāmeṣā ca divi devatā ।rohiṇī na vinā candraṁ muhūrttamapi dṛśyate ॥ 2.118.11॥

translations.english: Rohini, the very best among all women and the goddess of heaven, is never seen in the sky separated from the moon even for a moment.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर, बचन बोलने वानां में चतुर और बड़े विद्वान वसिष्ठ जी ने उन वाक्यविशारद श्रीराम से यह महत्व की बात कही

verses.sloka: एवंविधाश्च प्रवरा: स्त्रियो भर्तृदृढव्रता: ।देवलोके महीयन्ते पुण्येन स्वेन कर्मणा ॥ २.११८.१२॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁvidhāśca pravarā: striyo bhartṛdṛḍhavratā: ।devaloke mahīyante puṇyena svena karmaṇā ॥ 2.118.12॥

translations.english: Execellent women such as these, firm in their vows to their husband are highly revered in the world of gods through their own meritorious deeds.
translations.hindi: हे महाप्राज्ञ ! तत्र इस समय तुम हर्षित हो, प्रतिनिधि के समान अपनी इन सुवणेभूषित खड़ाउओं को दे दो और अयोध्या के योगक्षेम में तत्पर बने रहो

verses.sloka: ततो ऽनसूया संहृष्टा श्रुत्वोक्तं सीतया वच: ।शिरस्याघ्राय चोवाच मैथिलीं हर्षयन्त्युत ॥ २.११८.१३॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'nasūyā saṁhṛṣṭā śrutvoktaṁ sītayā vaca: ।śirasyāghrāya covāca maithilīṁ harṣayantyuta ॥ 2.118.13॥

translations.english: Thereafter hearing Sita's words, Anasuya affectionately kissed her forehead and said this in order to make her happy:
translations.hindi: हे भरद्वाज जी वसिष्ठ जी के ये वचन सुन, श्रीराम जी ने यूवकी ओर मुख कर, इन खड़ाउओं को पहिना और राज्य के थालन की सामर्थ्य रखने वाली ये खड़ाऊं सुमे दे दीं

verses.sloka: नियमैर्विविधैराप्तं तपो हि महदस्ति मे ।तत्संश्रित्य बलं सीते छन्दये त्वां शुचिस्मिते ॥ २.११८.१४॥
verses.transliteration: niyamairvividhairāptaṁ tapo hi mahadasti me ।tatsaṁśritya balaṁ sīte chandaye tvāṁ śucismite ॥ 2.118.14॥

translations.english: O Sita of pure conduct, I have great ascetic power obtained through practising various austerities. With its strength I shall give what you want for your enjoyment.
translations.hindi: डन महात्मा श्रीराम की आज्ञा से, उनको लोटा लाने के उद्देश्य से निवृत्त हो कर, मैं अब इन शुभ खड़ाऊओं को ले, अयोध्या को लौटा जा रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: उपपन्नं मनोज्ञं च वचनं तव मैथिलि ।प्रीता चास्म्युचितं किं ते करवाणि ब्रवीहि मे ॥ २.११८.१५॥
verses.transliteration: upapannaṁ manojñaṁ ca vacanaṁ tava maithili ।prītā cāsmyucitaṁ kiṁ te karavāṇi bravīhi me ॥ 2.118.15॥

translations.english: O Sita, I am glad to hear your befitting and pleasing words. Tell me what appropriate thing you desire and I shall give you.
translations.hindi: महात्मा भरत जी के ये शुभ वचन सुन, महर्षि भरद्वाज जी उनसे ये झुभतर वचन बोले

verses.sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मिता मन्दविस्मया ।कृतमित्यब्रवीत्सीता तपोबलसमन्विताम् ॥ २.११८.१६॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā vismitā mandavismayā ।kṛtamityabravītsītā tapobalasamanvitām ॥ 2.118.16॥

translations.english: On hearing her words Sita was surprised. With a gentle smile she said, to Anasuya who was endowed with ascetic power, 'I think you have already granted me the boons'.
translations.hindi: हे सुशील ओर चरित्रवान्‌ पुरुषसिंह ! यह कोई आश्चयं की बात नहीं कि, तुममें ऐसी सुजनता है । क्योंकि पानी बह कर तो तालाब या गढ़ ही में जमा होता है

verses.sloka: सा त्वेवमुक्ता धर्मज्ञा तया प्रीततरा ऽभवत् ।सफलं च प्रहर्षं ते हन्त सीते करोम्यहम् ॥ २.११८.१७॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvevamuktā dharmajñā tayā prītatarā 'bhavat ।saphalaṁ ca praharṣaṁ te hanta sīte karomyaham ॥ 2.118.17॥

translations.english: When Sita said so, Anasuya who knew her righteous duty was immensely pleased. and replied, 'What a joy I shall make the words you have spoken come true'.
translations.hindi: जिनके तुम जैसे धर्मात्मा और धम वत्सल पुत्र हैं वे महाबाहु ४द्वाराज़ दशरथ अजर अमर हैं

verses.sloka: इदं दिव्यं वरं माल्यं वस्त्रमाभरणानि च ।अङ्गरागं च वैदेहि महार्हं चानुलेपनम् ॥ २.११८.१८॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ divyaṁ varaṁ mālyaṁ vastramābharaṇāni ca ।aṅgarāgaṁ ca vaidehi mahārhaṁ cānulepanam ॥ 2.118.18॥

translations.english: O princess of Videha, O Sita, I bestow on you this best garland of the gods, raiment, jewellery, fragrant unguents, and precious ointment for anointing your body with. All this will beautify your limbs. It is convenient (to use) and will never fade.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार सुनि का बचन सुन, भरत हाथ जोड़ और उनके चरण छु ओर बार वार परिक्रमा कर, उनसे विदा हो, मंत्रियों सहित अयोध्या को प्रस्थानित हुए

verses.sloka: मया दत्तमिदं सीते तव गात्राणि शोभयेत् ।अनुरूपमसंक्लिष्टं नित्यमेव भविष्यति ॥ २.११८.१९॥
verses.transliteration: mayā dattamidaṁ sīte tava gātrāṇi śobhayet ।anurūpamasaṁkliṣṭaṁ nityameva bhaviṣyati ॥ 2.118.19॥

translations.english: O princess of Videha, O Sita, I bestow on you this best garland of the gods, raiment, jewellery, fragrant unguents, and precious ointment for anointing your body with. All this will beautify your limbs. It is convenient (to use) and will never fade.

verses.sloka: अङ्गरागेण दिव्येन लिप्ताङ्गी जनकात्मजे ।शोभयिष्यसि भर्त्तारं यथा श्रीविष्णुमव्ययम् ॥ २.११८.२०॥
verses.transliteration: aṅgarāgeṇa divyena liptāṅgī janakātmaje ।śobhayiṣyasi bharttāraṁ yathā śrīviṣṇumavyayam ॥ 2.118.20॥

translations.english: O daughter of Janaka, you will enhance the glory of your husband by anointing your body with this divine, fragrant unguent to your body like Lakshmi enhancing the glory of eternal Visnu.
translations.hindi: अरत जी क साथ जा सेना थी, बह भी उनके पीछे होली । उस सेना के लोगों में से कोई रथां, कोई छकड़ों कोई हाथियों आर कोई धोड़ा पर सवार थे

verses.sloka: सा वस्त्रमङ्गरागं च भूषणानि स्रजस्तथा ।मैथिली प्रतिजग्राह प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम् ॥ २.११८.२१॥
verses.transliteration: sā vastramaṅgarāgaṁ ca bhūṣaṇāni srajastathā ।maithilī pratijagrāha prītidānamanuttamam ॥ 2.118.21॥

translations.english: That princess from Mithila accepted the incomparable gifts of love, the raiment, fragrant unguents, jewellery and also the garland.

verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सीता प्रीतिदानं यशस्विनी ।श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा तत्र समुपास्त तपोधनाम् ॥ २.११८.२२॥
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tat sītā prītidānaṁ yaśasvinī ।śliṣṭāñjalipuṭā tatra samupāsta tapodhanām ॥ 2.118.22॥

translations.english: Illustrious Sita accepted the gifts of love and with palms folded in reverence sat beside her, an ascetic.

verses.sloka: तथा सीतासुपासीनामनसूया दृढव्रता ।वचनं प्रष्टुमारेभे काञ्चित् प्रियकथामनु ॥ २.११८.२३॥
verses.transliteration: tathā sītāsupāsīnāmanasūyā dṛḍhavratā ।vacanaṁ praṣṭumārebhe kāñcit priyakathāmanu ॥ 2.118.23॥

translations.english: Anasuya who was firm in her vows commenced to ask Sita this way about a certain tale (that was close to her heart).
translations.hindi: ृङ्गवेरपुर से, चल कर भरत उस अयोध्यापुरी में पहुँचे, जो कि, उनके पिता महाराज दशरथ से और भाई श्रीराम से हीन थी

verses.sloka: स्वयंवरे किल प्राप्ता त्वमनेन यशस्विना ।राघवेणेति मे सीते कथा श्रुतिमुपागता ॥ २.११८.२४॥
verses.transliteration: svayaṁvare kila prāptā tvamanena yaśasvinā ।rāghaveṇeti me sīte kathā śrutimupāgatā ॥ 2.118.24॥

translations.english: O Sita, I have heard that you have been won by the illustrious Rama in the swayamvara. At least that is the story which reached my ears.

verses.sloka: तां कथां श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण च मैथिलि ।यथानुभूतं कार्त्स्न्येन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ २.११८.२५॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ kathāṁ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa ca maithili ।yathānubhūtaṁ kārtsnyena tanme tvaṁ vaktumarhasi ॥ 2.118.25॥

translations.english: O daughter of Mithila, I would like to hear the story in detail. You should tell me the whole story as you experienced it.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता तु सा सीता तां ततो धर्मचारिणीम् ।श्रूयतामिति चोक्त्वा वै कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥ २.११८.२६॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu sā sītā tāṁ tato dharmacāriṇīm ।śrūyatāmiti coktvā vai kathayāmāsa tāṁ kathām ॥ 2.118.26॥

translations.english: 'Listen' said Sita, thus addressed, and began relating the story to Anasuya, a performer of austerities.

verses.sloka: मिथिलाधिपतिर्वीरो जनको नाम धर्मवित् ।क्षत्ऺत्रधर्मे ह्यभिरतो न्यायत: शास्ति मेदिनीम् ॥ २.११८.२७॥
verses.transliteration: mithilādhipatirvīro janako nāma dharmavit ।kṣatऺtradharme hyabhirato nyāyata: śāsti medinīm ॥ 2.118.27॥

translations.english: There is a king in Mithila, Janaka by name. He is heroic and is conversant with righteousness. Engaged in the duties of a kshatriya, he is rules the earth with justice.

verses.sloka: तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तस्य कर्षत: क्षेत्रमण्डलम् ।अहं किलोत्थिता भित्त्वा जगतीं नृपते: सुता ॥ २.११८.२८॥
verses.transliteration: tasya lāṅgalahastasya karṣata: kṣetramaṇḍalam ।ahaṁ kilotthitā bhittvā jagatīṁ nṛpate: sutā ॥ 2.118.28॥

translations.english: When he was ploughing the circular plot of land for performing a sacrifice, it is said I emerged from the earth by breaking it and therefore I became his dauhghter.

verses.sloka: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्पर: ।पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं जनको विस्मितो ऽभवत् ॥ २.११८.२९॥
verses.transliteration: sa māṁ dṛṣṭvā narapatirmuṣṭivikṣepatatpara: ।pāṁsukuṇṭhitasarvāṅgīṁ janako vismito 'bhavat ॥ 2.118.29॥

translations.english: Engaged in sowing fistfuls of seeds, king Janaka found me covered with dust and was astonished.

verses.sloka: अनपत्येन च स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य च स्वयम् ।ममेयं तनयेत्युक्त्वा स्नेहो मयि निपातित: ॥ २.११८.३०॥
verses.transliteration: anapatyena ca snehādaṅkamāropya ca svayam ।mameyaṁ tanayetyuktvā sneho mayi nipātita: ॥ 2.118.30॥

translations.english: As he had no children, he, on his own accord, lifted me up and placing me on his lap, saying, This is my daughter, he began showering (lots of) love on me.

verses.sloka: अन्तरिक्षे च वागुक्ता प्रति मा ऽमानुषी किल ।एवमेतन्नरपते धर्मेण तनया तव ॥ २.११८.३१॥
verses.transliteration: antarikṣe ca vāguktā prati mā 'mānuṣī kila ।evametannarapate dharmeṇa tanayā tava ॥ 2.118.31॥

translations.english: 'O king, she is an incomparable divine being. By right she is your daughter'. These were the words (Janaka) heard from out of the sky.

verses.sloka: तत: प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा पिता मे मिथिलाधिप: ।अवाप्तो विपुलामृद्धिं मामवाप्य नराधिप: ॥ २.११८.३२॥
verses.transliteration: tata: prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā pitā me mithilādhipa: ।avāpto vipulāmṛddhiṁ māmavāpya narādhipa: ॥ 2.118.32॥

translations.english: Thereafter, my father and the righteous lord of Mithila was delighted in possessing me when a noble thought struck his mind.

verses.sloka: दत्ता चास्मीष्टवद्देव्यै ज्येष्ठायै पुण्यकर्मणा ।तया सम्भाविता चास्मि स्निग्धया मातृसौहृदात् ॥ २.११८.३३॥
verses.transliteration: dattā cāsmīṣṭavaddevyai jyeṣṭhāyai puṇyakarmaṇā ।tayā sambhāvitā cāsmi snigdhayā mātṛsauhṛdāt ॥ 2.118.33॥

translations.english: Bestowed as the choicest one of meritorious acts on the chief queen, I was brought up by her, by nature affectionate, with the love of a mother.

verses.sloka: पतिसंयोगसुलभं वयो दृष्ट्वा तु मे पिता ।चिन्तामभ्यगमद्दीनो वित्तनाशादिवाधन: ॥ २.११८.३४॥
verses.transliteration: patisaṁyogasulabhaṁ vayo dṛṣṭvā tu me pitā ।cintāmabhyagamaddīno vittanāśādivādhana: ॥ 2.118.34॥

translations.english: When my father saw I had attained the marriageable age, he was immersed in sorrow like an indigent man who had lost all his wealth.

verses.sloka: सदृशाच्चापकृष्टाच्च लोके कन्यापिता जनात् ।प्रधर्षणमवाप्नोति शक्रेणापि समो भुवि ॥ २.११८.३५॥
verses.transliteration: sadṛśāccāpakṛṣṭācca loke kanyāpitā janāt ।pradharṣaṇamavāpnoti śakreṇāpi samo bhuvi ॥ 2.118.35॥

translations.english: Even though he was an Indra on earth, as a father of an unmarried girl he would be humiliated by men who are his equal or inferior in this world.

verses.sloka: तां धर्षणामदूरस्थां दृष्ट्वा चात्मनि पार्थिव: ।चिन्तार्णवगत: पारं नाससादाप्लवो यथा ॥ २.११८.३६॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dharṣaṇāmadūrasthāṁ dṛṣṭvā cātmani pārthiva: ।cintārṇavagata: pāraṁ nāsasādāplavo yathā ॥ 2.118.36॥

translations.english: Having perceived that the humiliation is not very far, king Janaka was plunged in a sea of sorrow like one who cannot reach the shore without a float.

verses.sloka: अयोनिजां हि मां ज्ञात्वा नाध्यगच्छद्विचिन्तयन् ।सदृशं चानुरूपं च महीपाल: पतिं मम ॥ २.११८.३७॥
verses.transliteration: ayonijāṁ hi māṁ jñātvā nādhyagacchadvicintayan ।sadṛśaṁ cānurūpaṁ ca mahīpāla: patiṁ mama ॥ 2.118.37॥

translations.english: The ruler of the earth knew that I was not born from a woman's womb, and could not find a suitable husband for me after deep reflection.

verses.sloka: तस्य बुद्धिरियं जाता चिन्तयानस्य सन्ततम् ।स्वयं वरं तनूजाया: करिष्यामीति धीमत: ॥ २.११८.३८॥
verses.transliteration: tasya buddhiriyaṁ jātā cintayānasya santatam ।svayaṁ varaṁ tanūjāyā: kariṣyāmīti dhīmata: ॥ 2.118.38॥

translations.english: After constantly pondering over the matter, the wise king arrived at the decision to perform a swayamvara for his daughter.

verses.sloka: महायज्ञे तदा तस्य वरुणेन महात्मना ।दत्तं धनुर्वरं प्रीत्या तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ ॥ २.११८.३९॥
verses.transliteration: mahāyajñe tadā tasya varuṇena mahātmanā ।dattaṁ dhanurvaraṁ prītyā tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau ॥ 2.118.39॥

translations.english: Magnanimous Varuna out of his affection had given him, on the occasion of a great sacrifice, an excellent bow with inexhaustible arrows and a pair of quivers.

verses.sloka: असञ्चाल्यं मनुष्यैश्च यत्नेनापि च गौरवात् ।तन्न शक्ता नमयितुं स्वप्नेष्वपि नराधिपा: ॥ २.११८.४०॥
verses.transliteration: asañcālyaṁ manuṣyaiśca yatnenāpi ca gauravāt ।tanna śaktā namayituṁ svapneṣvapi narādhipā: ॥ 2.118.40॥

translations.english: Because of its weight, no human could move that bow despite great effort nor were the kings capable of bending it even in their dreams.

verses.sloka: तद्धनु: प्राप्य मे पित्रा व्याहृतं सत्यवादिना ।समवाये नरेन्द्राणां पूर्वमामन्त्र्य पार्थिवान् ॥ २.११८.४१॥
verses.transliteration: taddhanu: prāpya me pitrā vyāhṛtaṁ satyavādinā ।samavāye narendrāṇāṁ pūrvamāmantrya pārthivān ॥ 2.118.41॥

translations.english: My truthful father, after having acquired the bow, invited all the princes and placed the great bow before them in the assembly where he declared:

verses.sloka: इदं च धनुरुद्यम्य सज्यं य: कुरुते नर: ।तस्य मे दुहिता भार्या भविष्यति न संशय: ॥ २.११८.४२॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ ca dhanurudyamya sajyaṁ ya: kurute nara: ।tasya me duhitā bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṁśaya: ॥ 2.118.42॥

translations.english: Whatever man lifts this bow and strings it, to him my daughter shall become his wife—of this there is no doubt.

verses.sloka: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनु: श्रेष्ठं गौरवाद्गिरिसन्निभम् ।अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने ॥ २.११८.४३॥
verses.transliteration: tacca dṛṣṭvā dhanu: śreṣṭhaṁ gauravādgirisannibham ।abhivādya nṛpā jagmuraśaktāstasya tolane ॥ 2.118.43॥

translations.english: Beholding the mighty bow resembling a mountain in weight, the kings, unable to lift it, paid their homage and left.

verses.sloka: सुदीर्घस्य तु कालस्य राघवो ऽयं महाद्युति: ।विश्वामित्रेण सहितो यज्ञं द्रष्टुं समागत: ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा राम: सत्यपराक्रम: ॥ २.११८.४४॥
verses.transliteration: sudīrghasya tu kālasya rāghavo 'yaṁ mahādyuti: ।viśvāmitreṇa sahito yajñaṁ draṣṭuṁ samāgata: ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāma: satyaparākrama: ॥ 2.118.44॥

translations.english: After a long time, resplendent Rama whose prowess was truth, arrived along with his brother Lakshman and sage Viswamitra in order to witness the sacrifice.

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा मम पित्रा सुपूजित: ।प्रोवाच पितरं तत्र भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥ २.११८.४५॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitrastu dharmātmā mama pitrā supūjita: ।provāca pitaraṁ tatra bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ॥ 2.118.45॥

translations.english: Having accepted the honour extended by my father, righteous Viswamitra spoke to him about those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: सुतौ दशरथस्येमौ धनुर्दर्शनकांक्षिणौ ।धनुर्दर्शय रामाय राजपुत्राय दैविकम् ॥ २.११८.४६॥
verses.transliteration: sutau daśarathasyemau dhanurdarśanakāṁkṣiṇau ।dhanurdarśaya rāmāya rājaputrāya daivikam ॥ 2.118.46॥

translations.english: 'Both these sons of king Dasaratha wish to see the bow. Show the divine bow to prince Rama'.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तस्तेन विप्रेण तद्धनु: समुपानयत् ।निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदानम्य स वीर्य्यवान् ॥ २.११८.४७॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena vipreṇa taddhanu: samupānayat ।nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tadānamya sa vīryyavān ॥ 2.118.47॥

translations.english: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.

verses.sloka: ज्यां समारोप्य झटिति पूरयामास वीर्यवत् ॥ २.११८.४८॥
verses.transliteration: jyāṁ samāropya jhaṭiti pūrayāmāsa vīryavat ॥ 2.118.48॥

translations.english: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.

verses.sloka: तेन पूरयता वेगान्मध्ये भग्नं द्विधा धनु: ।तस्य शब्दो ऽभवद्भीम: पतितस्याशनेरिव ॥ २.११८.४९॥
verses.transliteration: tena pūrayatā vegānmadhye bhagnaṁ dvidhā dhanu: ।tasya śabdo 'bhavadbhīma: patitasyāśaneriva ॥ 2.118.49॥

translations.english: When Rama was stringing the bow with force, it was broken into two in the middle and fell down with a dreadful sound like that of thunder.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽहं तत्र रामाय पित्रा सत्याभिसन्धिना ।निश्चिता दातुमुद्यम्य जलभाजनमुत्तमम् ॥ २.११८.५०॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṁ tatra rāmāya pitrā satyābhisandhinā ।niścitā dātumudyamya jalabhājanamuttamam ॥ 2.118.50॥

translations.english: Then, my father steadfast in truth, held a vessel of pure water and declared his decision to offer me to Rama.

verses.sloka: दीयमानां न तु तदा प्रतिजग्राह राघव: ।अविज्ञाय पितुश्छन्दमयोध्याधिपते: प्रभो: ॥ २.११८.५१॥
verses.transliteration: dīyamānāṁ na tu tadā pratijagrāha rāghava: ।avijñāya pituśchandamayodhyādhipate: prabho: ॥ 2.118.51॥

translations.english: Then Rama did not accept the offer of my father straightaway before he knew the opinion of his father Dasaratha, king of Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: तत: श्वशुरमामन्त्र्य वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम् ।मम पित्रा त्वहं दत्ता रामाय विदितात्मने ॥ २.११८.५२॥
verses.transliteration: tata: śvaśuramāmantrya vṛddhaṁ daśarathaṁ nṛpam ।mama pitrā tvahaṁ dattā rāmāya viditātmane ॥ 2.118.52॥

translations.english: Thereafter, my fatherinlaw, the aged king Dasaratha was invited and my father offered me to Rama known for his sagacity.

verses.sloka: मम चैवानुजा साध्वी ऊर्मिला प्रियदर्शना ।भार्य्यार्थे लक्ष्मणस्यापि दत्ता पित्रा मम स्वयम् ॥ २.११८.५३॥
verses.transliteration: mama caivānujā sādhvī ūrmilā priyadarśanā ।bhāryyārthe lakṣmaṇasyāpi dattā pitrā mama svayam ॥ 2.118.53॥

translations.english: My father, on his own accord, bestowed Urmila, my younger sister of chaste and of pleasing appearance as wife to Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: एवं दत्तास्मि रामाय तदा तस्मिन् स्वयम्वरे ।अनुरक्तास्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम् ॥ २.११८.५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ dattāsmi rāmāya tadā tasmin svayamvare ।anuraktāsmi dharmeṇa patiṁ vīryavatāṁ varam ॥ 2.118.54 ॥

translations.english: In this way my father bestowed me on Rama in that swayamvara and I remain devoted to my husband who is the foremost among the valiant in treading the path of righteousness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the one hundredeighteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
